entries.name: MICROSOFT_TENANT_ID
entries.description: The directory (tenant) id of the store's Microsoft 365 organization, which the app signs in to.
howToGet: Signed in to the Microsoft Entra admin center as an admin, open Overview and copy the Tenant ID.

entries.name: MICROSOFT_CLIENT_ID
entries.description: The application (client) id of the store's KaratOS app registration, given Sites.Selected with the read role on one SharePoint site and nothing else.
howToGet: In the Entra admin center, open App registrations, choose New registration, name it KaratOS, keep single tenant and register it.
In its API permissions, remove User.Read, add the Microsoft Graph application permission Sites.Selected, and grant admin consent. Add nothing else.
Grant the app the read role on the one site that holds the library, as the connector's docs page shows, then copy the Application (client) ID from Overview.

entries.name: MICROSOFT_CLIENT_SECRET
entries.description: A client secret of the KaratOS app, sent only to Microsoft's sign-in for a one-hour Graph token. The connector stops if that token carries any permission that isn't a read one.
howToGet: In the KaratOS app's Certificates & secrets, choose New client secret, describe it as KaratOS and pick the shortest expiry the store is happy to renew.
Copy its Value (not its Secret ID) straight into the host's secret store. Never paste it into chat or an issue.

entries.name: MICROSOFT_ONEDRIVE_DRIVE_ID
entries.description: The drive id of the document library to read, such as the site's Documents library. It starts with b!.
howToGet: In Graph Explorer, signed in as an admin, run GET https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/sites/{host}:/sites/{site}?$select=id with the site's host and name from its address, and note the id.
Run GET https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/sites/{site id}/drives?$select=id,name and copy the id of the library to read.

entries.name: MICROSOFT_ONEDRIVE_FILE_NAMES
entries.description: keep (the default) keeps file and folder names, which can name customers; drop keeps only ids, kinds and times.
howToGet: Leave unset to keep names. Set drop if the store names files after customers and would rather not keep them.

entries.name: MICROSOFT_GRAPH_CLIENT_STATE
entries.description: The clientState the drive's change notification subscription was made with. Graph sends it back with each notification, and one that carries it prompts the incremental sync.
howToGet: Leave unset to sync on a schedule only, which is what most stores want: Graph only lets an app subscribe to a drive with Files.Read.All, which reads every site and OneDrive in the organization, not Sites.Selected.

To have changes prompt a sync, generate 32 random characters on the host, save them straight into the host's secret store, and use them as clientState when an admin makes the subscription. Never paste them into chat or an issue.
